title: Yeh'kinya, the Ancient Egg, and Hakkar
summary: An offered task becomes an uneasy investigation: spirits, tablets and an ancient vessel lead to a Sunken Temple avatar, then to evidence that Yeh'kinya means to return Hakkar. The tour stops at the request for aid on Yojamba Isle.
opening: A port-side request reaches from Feralas to the Hinterlands and the drowned halls of the Sunken Temple. The egg is entrusted with an essence, the tablets return with a warning, and the seeker learns that Yeh'kinya's promise concealed another purpose. This is the Classic quest chain's boundary; the later Zul'Gurub summoning belongs to a separate campaign.

chapters.title: The request and the relics
chapters.body: The bramble, Vale Screechers, Mosh'aru tablets and Ancient Egg assemble the plan Yeh'kinya presents. Collection objectives remain distinct from unique historical events.

chapters.title: The avatar and the egg
chapters.body: The Sunken Temple rite summons an avatar. Its defeat and the egg's uneasy containment do not equal Hakkar's later physical summoning in Zul'Gurub.

chapters.title: Six tablets and a revelation
chapters.body: Ironboot's tablet search supplies a warning, Yeh'kinya discloses his purpose, and Molthor receives a request for aid. The raid outcome is outside the cutoff.

reviewNote: Complete illustrated research transcript with 15 nodes, eight Classic-area environments, original actor/group/relic art, relational scene states, and per-beat source/citation/claim records. Lore review remains open: secondary Classic quest locators, original-client dialogue/build verification, in-game resemblance comparison, art composition and voice audition. The Sunken Temple summons an avatar; the Burning Crusade manual separates it from Zul'Gurub's later physical summoning. Yeh'kinya's motives and escape are attributed. The story ends at the Yojamba request for aid and does not show the raid.
